policy: Record only the strongest claim directly supported by exercised evidence. Every entry must list untested boundaries and remaining uncertainty. Never infer production finality from local, mock, CI, preview or synthetic evidence.

exercised_boundaries: string
remaining_uncertainty: string

entries.claim: A localhost-only read-only harness and eight-campaign registry now produce exact-SHA percentile/error/throughput evidence; three bounded liveness campaigns passed provisional local thresholds without supporting a capacity or production claim.
exercised_boundaries: Baseline processed 100 requests at concurrency 1 with zero errors and 3.263 ms p95.
Burst processed 500 requests at concurrency 20 with zero errors and 29.481 ms p95.
Short sustained load processed 1,000 requests at concurrency 5 with zero errors and 13.623 ms p95.
Remote target execution was rejected before request.
Threshold breach now returns a failing process status and known-bad profiles/samples fail validation.
The final server process was terminated after measurement.
Compliance, typecheck, clean lint, 126/126 tests and exact-SHA production build passed.
remaining_uncertainty: The liveness path does not exercise database, provider or business truth.
The local machine and short request-count campaign do not establish a capacity ceiling or production SLO.
